notes: Silent English-captioned desktop simulation. The robot's on-screen position is driven by simulator_true_distance/simulator_time from the seed-10000 'repeated' trace (unmodified), so relative speed between normal/slow segments is physically accurate, not stylised. The halo/flash reports the controller's belief about speed (red/teal/violet), not position: distance is corrected by direct sensor readings every step regardless of architecture, so a position-only marker would not show the memory effect, which lives specifically in the speed estimate. Jump moments (violet flash) are real discontinuities (>1.5 cm/s) detected directly in estimated_speed, not added for effect. The reconvergence numbers in the closing chapter are 100-trial averages from results_ext1/reconvergence_summary.csv, not read off this one illustrative trial. No physical robot data or hardware validation is presented.
